admission.justification: Realized jointly in standalone_pr_landing.py::is_pr_landed_standalone_candidate and integration_branch_authority.py::standalone_master_status, proved by test_checkpoint_sprint_master_and_pr_leaf_keep_todays_refusals, and required to bound the standalone PR end family.

applicability: Worktree contracts evaluated for pull-request-landed standalone master finalization or pre-Completed cleanup admission.
conditions: The contract has kind == 'series', integration_strategy == 'pr', integration_status == 'completed', and closeout_status != 'completed'.
Integration branch authority proves sprint_ref is None through standalone_master_status or _master_authority.
exclusions: Leaf contracts (kind != 'series'), which keep existing closeout readiness checks.
Sprint-commanded masters (sprint_ref is not None), which keep existing closeout and Completed-before-cleanup checks.
Checkpointed series (integration_status == 'checkpointed'), which remain blocked by integration-not-complete.
Series that already closed out (closeout_status == 'completed'), which keep the closed-out finalization route.
statement: A standalone master whose pull-request landing is recorded is a series contract with no commanding sprint (sprint_ref is None), integration_strategy == 'pr', integration_status == 'completed', and closeout_status != 'completed'.
title: PR-landed standalone master eligibility predicate
